message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a caricature of three men positioned against a pale, architectural background with columns. The central figure, located in the lower foreground, is a man with a round face, squinting eyes, and a mole on his chin. He wears a black peci cap and a white collared shirt. He holds both hands up, palms facing forward. Behind him and to the left is another man with dark, slicked-back hair and a light mustache, also wearing a white collared shirt. To the right, slightly further back, a third man with thin hair and a prominent forehead smiles with eyes closed. 

Large red text across the top reads "TEMPO," with a black-and-white barcode and QR code to the right. Below the masthead, smaller text includes "Berburu Makelar Kasus Korupsi Pemancar H.64" and "Perang Dagang di Batang Toru H.74." Bold black text on the left reads "KARENA JOKOWI DEMI JOKOWI." Smaller Indonesian text follows, ending with "H.26." The overall color palette uses warm, illustrative tones with soft lighting on the figures.
